description:
Discover an unforgettable story of romance in this captivating visual novel. It all begins with a magical moment: a fleeting glance, a racing heartbeat... and a love that changes everything. Our protagonist crosses paths with a mysterious girl in a chance encounter and in that moment, he knows he must find her again.

Driven by the certainty that she is his soul mate, he will begin a search full of excitement, unexpected encounters and crucial decisions. Every choice you make will shape his destiny: will he succeed in reuniting with her and winning her heart, or will his love fade like an unattainable dream?

Immerse yourself in a moving story where destiny and romance intertwine. Experience an experience full of feelings, dilemmas and moments that will make your heart race. Are you ready to follow the signs of love?
name: Love at First Sight
intro: A love at first sight sparks a passionate quest. Make choices and shape her destiny in this visual novel.
